snippet.title: Awakeness: YALDA Night // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4277200/Awakeness_YALDA_Night

Awakeness is a first-person psychological horror set in Barzakh, a higher layer of reality where space and emotion distort. Explore looping corridors, solve subtle environmental puzzles, and evade an unseen presence using stealth and light.

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer: Mind Ashes
📚 Publisher: Mind Ashes
📅 Release Date: Coming Soon
🎯 Genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play, Horror

Mature Content Description
The developers describe the content like this:

The game features atmospheric horror elements and a specific scene in a yellow building where a character (referred to as the "jumper") falls/jumps from a height. While this event is integrated into the story and does not depict or promote intentional self-harm or suicide within the narrative, the visual representation closely resembles a suicide act. Players who have sensitivities to suicide themes or falling trauma should be aware of this before playing.
